QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] A Quick Look Back
QuestInfo.0: To return to where your adventures first began... Where WAS it that it all started?
QuestInfo.1: You discovered how to find your lost memories. Call forth the Taotie and have a chat about the old days.
QuestInfo.2: You bickered with the Taotie and talked about how your strange adventures had their start. It was...strangely nostalgic, in a way.
